entities.summary: Albert Maximo Cristina is a retired volleyball player from the Netherlands, who represented his native country at two consecutive Summer Olympics, starting in 2000. After having finished in fifth place in Sydney, Australia, he ended up in ninth place with the Dutch Men's National Team four years later in Athens, Greece.
